mode: HZO 1T1C binary memory with reference local exact-integer digital CIM, destructive sensing and mandatory full activated-row writeback

provenance.original_values: Local PDF pages/Figs audited; see notes/evidence.zh.md
provenance.reference_choice: This is an engineering organization over measured HZO memory evidence, not a measured CIM macro

mapping.cell_state: binary remanent polarization; 1 FeCAP per bit
mapping.logical_to_physical: s=i mod32; physical_row=8 floor(i/32)+floor(j/16); column=8(j mod16)+k
mapping.plate_sequence: hold PL=Vw then hold PL=0; BL=0 for target0 and BL=Vw for target1; VFE is PL-BL
mapping.unselected_rows: WL off; independently selected local row PL and write domain; no shared destructive activation beyond the 128-bit row
mapping.precision: INT8 x INT8 to exact signed 24-bit output conditional on binary memory functionality; no analog multi-level weight

budget_rationale.sense: 8 ns sense demonstrated at 2.5 V in FERAM-03 p1/Fig11; 20/50 ns are longer design windows within its 1-50 ns sweep, not measured complete read periods
budget_rationale.polarization: FERAM-03 reports 14 ns write latency, not a proven isolated single polarity pulse. Model deliberately reserves 14/50/100 ns for EACH target-polarity phase in selected two-phase PL implementation. 50 ns is within Fig11 sweep; 100 ns characterization is in Figs10/12. No claim that original 14 ns measurement required two times 14 ns.
budget_rationale.dedicated_open_close: 20/40/80 ns total allocation for BL precharge/reference, WL/PL bias establishment, pulse edges, SA reset and return to reusable state excluding polarization holds. Short=10+10 ns open/close (round above 8 ns observed sense); reference=20+20; long=40+40. FERAM-03 Fig9 establishes required stages; FERAM-04 Fig13 tRP=80 ns and complete tRC=185 ns cross-check scale, NOT a disjoint timing block to add. No PVT guarantee or measured per-stage split.
budget_rationale.voltage: Measured anchor FERAM-03: 11 nm TiN/HZO/TiN, 2.5 V, 1 um2 capacitor tested. Memory voltage domain and compatible access/level-shift circuitry retained as a design requirement; shared 28 nm 0.9 V applies to digital periphery only, with no geometric speed scaling.
budget_rationale.write_parallelism: 128 target BL drivers and one selected local plate driver provisioned for a whole128bit row, independently of 128bit input interface; 32 read SA banks support parallel restore from their own latches. Updating externally is serialized by choice to one target-data/decoder domain.
budget_rationale.endpoint: Open-loop binary write, no analog verify or unspecified retries. Conditional capacity is for cells passing binary-state read/write qualification under stated window; failure beyond budget is failed service, not extra successful payload.

read_includes: capture SA output into 4096-bit round operand register before reset; budgeted in dedicated open/close control
stage_coverage.refresh: No scheduled refresh in active service window for remanent 1T1C state. Destructive writeback is paid every physical read. Retention/lifetime separate; no C2 floating-node assumption.
stage_coverage.read_latch_condition: D0 round output data survive SA reset; D1 adds independent 4096-bit hold and one capture tick per group for eight-input-bit reuse

reuse_sensitivity.purpose: Read and restore once, capture all 4096 bits, then compute all 8 input-bit rounds before next group; same matrix and same resident update domain
